==Description==
'''Blessed''' is a status effect which boosts the [[Defense]] of enemies.

==Mechanics==
When applied, increases an enemy's [[Defense]] by 100%. If the enemy has existing [[Defense]], the bonus is added to the existing value. For example, an enemy such as the [[Armored]] with 50% [[Defense]] will have 150% [[Defense]] when '''Blessed'''.

If an enemy has had its [[Defense]] reduced, the reduction will be the same as the enemy without [[Blessed]]. For example, an enemy with 100% [[Defense]] will have burn reduce it from 100% to 50%. When [[Blessed]] is applied, it will have its [[Defense]] reduced from 200% to 150%. This however does not mean the 100% given by '''Blessed''' cannot be melted, but it does require stacking melting sources to reach over 100% melting. If for instance poison, burn and electric melting sources are all combined, then the same enemy's [[Defense]] with '''Blessed''' will be reduced from 200% to 80%.

==Enemy List==
The following enemies have '''Blessed''' by default:
*[[Vindicator]] (With Shield)

The following enemies can spawn with '''Blessed''', but do not have it by default:
*[[Phantom]] ([[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]])
*[[Balloon]]
*[[Elite Lead]] ([[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]])
*[[Slow King]] ([[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]], [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]])
*[[Void Floater]] ([[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]])
*[[Elite Void Rusher]] ([[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]])
*[[Soul]] ([[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]], [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]])

The following enemies can get '''Blessed''', but only through ability usage:
*[[Champion Templar]] (''Fiery Boon'')

The following event enemies could spawn with '''Blessed''', but did not have it by default:
*[[Soccer Ball]] ([[Backyard Legends Event|Backyard Legends]])
*[[Soccer Head]] ([[Backyard Legends Event|Backyard Legends]])
*[[Whistle]] ([[Backyard Legends Event|Backyard Legends]])
*[[Duffle Bag]] ([[Backyard Legends Event|Backyard Legends]])
*[[Referee]] ([[Backyard Legends Event|Backyard Legends]])

==Tower & Unit List==
Although no known use on towers for this attribute exists, the following towers used to have '''Blessed''':
*[[Golden Snowballer]]

==Update History==
*'''23 July 2025''' - [[v1.71.0]]
**'''Blessed''' added.
**{{Bug}} [[Defense]] can be reduced if the total defense melt exceeds 100%.
*'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]]
**No longer prevents [[Defense]] melting of either the [[Defense]] already on the enemy or added to it by '''Blessed''', though the added [[Defense]] does not boost the maximum [[Defense]] a melting source can reduce.
